pr.title: Fix race condition in token refresh (#482)
pr.body:
## Why
Two concurrent requests can both trigger a token refresh; the second invalidates the first and logs the user out. Root cause: no mutual exclusion around refresh.

## What
Serialize refreshes behind a single in-flight promise so concurrent callers await the same result.

## Testing
Added a unit test firing 10 concurrent calls asserting exactly one network refresh. Verified manually against staging.

## Risk
Low; lock is per-session. Follow-up needed for multi-tab coordination.
commits: Serialize token refresh behind a single in-flight promise
Add concurrency test for token refresh

items.note: Concise but explains motivation and trade-off.

pr.title: Cache template parse results to cut p95 latency
pr.body: Parsing issue-form YAML on every request showed up as 40% of p95 latency in profiling. This memoizes parsed templates keyed by content hash. Trade-off: a small unbounded cache; acceptable because the key space is the number of templates per repo (single digits). Verified with the existing template tests plus a new cache-hit assertion.
commits: Memoize parsed templates by content hash

items.note: Bug fix with repro and root cause.

pr.title: Prevent crash on issues with null body
pr.body: Reported in #1203: the scorer threw when `issue.body` was null (GitHub returns null, not empty string, for bodyless issues). Root cause was an unguarded `.length`. Added a null-coalesce at the boundary and a regression test reproducing the null-body payload.
commits: Guard against null issue body in extractor

items.note: Borderline: short but has a concrete why. Should NOT be slop.

pr.title: Bump request timeout to 25s
pr.body: The default 10s timeout was tripping on cold-start Lambdas behind the gateway. 25s keeps us under the 30s gateway limit while covering observed cold starts.
commits: Bump request timeout to 25s for cold starts
